summary: Dialogue phrase counter cuts scenes short
description: Author's own note at OPIL-source.bas:873 - 'DEFEITO NO CONTADOR DE FRASE, CORTA RAPIDO E NAO TERMINA'. In the dialog: scene loop, DEC z runs at the top of the loop while EXIT IF z=0 is tested at the bottom, so a scene loses a beat and the final line is truncated. Needs a trace of z through the loop against the intended sentence count from z=RND(8)+1.

summary: Three of four cutscene categories are dead code
description: OPIL-source.bas:587 reads 'z=0 :\'z=RND(3)' - the category randomizer is commented out, so only the z=0 skyline branch ever executes. The four backgrounds (midl/dock/citi/spac) are all still reachable via the sc chooser inside that branch, so this is about the three unwritten scene categories, not unreachable art. Decide whether to author them or remove the scaffolding.

summary: Document a reliable XRoar invocation and capture reference footage
description: Confirmed the disk contains LOADER.BAS + P/P.00/P.01 and README now documents 'xroar -m coco2b -load-fd0 OPIL-EN.dsk -type RUN\"LOADER\"'. Still to verify: whether coco2b is the right machine profile vs coco3, correct timing/frame rate, and whether the -type autorun is reliable from cold boot. Capture screenshots or video of each scene type for the README.

summary: object: routine has only two props
description: Only the briefcase (z=0) and safe (z=1) are implemented, selected by z=RND(2). A block of blank lines before the RETURN at OPIL-source.bas:583 marks where more props were planned. The safe's lights-down/lights-up index trick is a good template for adding more.

summary: Portrait arrays over-dimensioned by 18 bytes each
description: All ten portraits are DIM'd at 176 bytes but the draw loops in drawchrl/drawchrr only reach index 14+9*16=158. Roughly 170 bytes wasted across ten characters. Harmless today; worth reclaiming only if the program approaches a memory ceiling.

summary: No build pipeline - .dsk images cannot be rebuilt from source
description: The repo has OPIL-source.bas and two prebuilt .dsk images, but no documented ugBASIC command line to regenerate them. Without this, no source change can be tested. Blocks work on issues 1, 2 and 4.
